title: The Hawaii trip, illness and retirement from singing
summary: She went to Hawaii at the end of 1956, was sick after returning, and did not resume a singing career in 1957.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues

I stopped -- what, about 1957. Yeah, it was at the end of 1956 that I went out to Hawaii. When I came back in '57, I --
First of all, a few months after I came back from Hawaii, I was sick. I went in the hospital. I had an operation.
So when I came out, I just didn't bother about resuming a singing career anymore. That's when I got involved in the school.
But I -- I don't know, I guess it was about maybe a year later that I finally got around to getting a horn.
And then I practiced for about a year. And they were doing this concert -- and I wanted to play the horn, and I played it.
But then after John Wilson said 'stick to singing, I decided to put it away for awhile.
